content:
olivia-sre: Quick postmortem follow-up: need owners for auto-rollback, blast-radius caps, deterministic canaries, and a rollback test harness. Short volunteers?

maria-eng: I'll take auto-rollback spec + runbook. Will propose thresholds and human-override UX. Target RFC: 2025-01-11.

liam-platform: I'll own blast-radius caps + flag-create guardrails. Draft: prod default 5%, stage 15%, dev no cap; teams can request exceptions. ETA: 2025-01-20.

devex-sarah: I'll produce flag templates and a CI lint that enforces rollbackConfig presence. ETA: 2025-01-08.

infra-amy: I'll add cohort_id to metrics so we can replay canary runs. ETA: 2025-01-09.

product-joe: I'll approve any defaults that touch billing/auth. Tag me on RFCs.

deploy-bot: Example deploy snippet:
```
deploy:
  cohort_percent: 5
  cohort_id: "canary-20250109-01"
  rollback:
    enabled: true
    rules:
      - metric: error_rate
        delta_pct: 0.004
        window_s: 180
```

maria-eng: Draft triggers: error_rate delta >= 0.4pct sustained 3m OR p95 +30% sustained 5m OR anomaly_score >0.85. Auto-pause then rollback after 2m if no resume. Logs + incident marker required.

liam-platform: We'll prevent creating flags > global_max unless approved_by present. Add audit events for create/update.

devex-sarah: Test harness plan: synthetic error injection to assert deploy-bot pauses and rolls back. Nightly CI + on deploy logic changes. Co-owner: maria-eng. ETA: 2025-01-15.

olivia-sre: Action list I'll add to the tracking board: Auto-rollback RFC (maria-eng 2025-01-11), Blast-radius enforcement (liam-platform 2025-01-20), Flag templates + CI (devex-sarah 2025-01-08), Cohort tagging (infra-amy 2025-01-09), Synthetic rollback test (maria-eng & devex-sarah 2025-01-15), Dashboard: recent auto-rollbacks (olivia-sre 2025-01-22).

product-joe: I'll circulate a short PM policy for rollout percentages.

olivia-sre: Scheduling a 30m sync next Thu 9am PT to review RFCs. Please open tickets and link them here. Closing thread unless blocker.
